The robot check-in was absolutely amazing! So fast and fun. Would definitely come back.
Room was clean and the location near Tokyo Disneyland is perfect for families.
Very unique experience with the robot staff. Kids loved it. Breakfast was decent.
The novelty of robot receptionists wore off quickly. Room was tiny and noisy.
Fascinating concept but the robots kept freezing and staff had to intervene constantly.
Great location, convenient for Disney parks. The rooms are small but functional.
The dinosaur robot at the front desk is terrifying but in a fun way! Loved every moment.
Beds were comfortable and the automated room controls were impressive. Good value.
Staff were very helpful when the robots didn't work properly. Location is excellent.
Overpriced for what you get. The gimmick is fun for five minutes then it's just a hotel.
Incredible futuristic experience! The facial recognition check-in worked perfectly.
Room smelled a bit musty but the overall experience was memorable and unique.
The concept is brilliant. My kids talked about the robot dinosaur for weeks after.
Walls are paper thin. Could hear everything from neighboring rooms all night.
Very efficient and modern. The smart room tablet controlled everything beautifully.
Interesting stay but nothing special beyond the robots. Breakfast was disappointing.
Perfect base for Disney. Clean rooms, friendly human staff when you need them.
The automated check-in failed twice and we waited 30 minutes in the lobby.
Absolutely loved it! The future is here. Cannot wait to come back to Japan.
Decent hotel. The robot theme is fun but don't expect luxury at this price point.
Showers are fantastic, beds are comfy, location unbeatable. Minor robot glitches aside.
The whole family had a blast. Not the most luxurious but unforgettable.
Check-out was seamless. Room was spotless. The robot porter carried our bags perfectly.
Too expensive for such a small room. The robot novelty is not worth the premium.
Good WiFi, comfortable bed, great location. The robotic theme is a nice bonus.
The staff robots are charming but the human staff were even more helpful and kind.
Very cool concept but felt more like a theme park than a real hotel. Not for everyone.
We had a minor issue and the human staff resolved it immediately. Great service.
Pillow menu was a lovely touch. Slept wonderfully. The robot show at check-in was fun.
The in-room projector works as a TV and it was a brilliant space-saving idea.
Nothing worked properly. Robots, room controls, even the lights were unreliable.
Highly recommend for tech lovers and families. Unique in every way.
Clean, modern, well-located. The robot staff add a fun novelty to the experience.
The dinosaur robot genuinely scared my toddler. Maybe a warning would be nice.
Fantastic stay overall. The future of hospitality is clearly being tested here.
Good hotel but nothing extraordinary once you ignore the robots.
The room was cozy and the automated check-in saved so much time. Very impressed.
Would have been perfect if the air conditioning worked properly. Staff were kind.
Amazing innovation! The hotel proves that technology can enhance hospitality.
Not worth the hype. Small rooms, average food, gimmicky robots.
